top_diagnoses.diagnosis: Ectopic endometriosis in the uterine round ligament
top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The patient presents with a subcutaneous mass in the pubic region, which is adherent to the uterine round ligament. The mass has an irregular shape and indistinct boundaries, and immunohistochemical analyses show positive staining for estrogen and progesterone receptors, CD10, and COX-2. The presence of endometrial glands and stroma, as well as the association with the uterine round ligament, support the diagnosis of ectopic endometriosis in the uterine round ligament.
